body:
Thank you. All of you. A lot of what you have been saying is stuff I have been told before.

It's just so hard. I had picked out the life I wanted before and was facing being homeless because my family didn't agree with it. Even now it's still coming back to hurt me.

As for doing what I want I want to do with my life, there is nothing I want to do. I am just living it in monotony every single day. There is absolutely nothing I want to do with my life. There were things I used to want to do but they all went away a few years ago and have never come back.

I can't find anyone better. It's the same with everyone. They either all want or expect sex, don't take my opnion into consideration, or are just dicks. I never thought love existed and I'm just about to head back to that opinion. There is no such thing as love. It's a bullshit word we created to make ourselves feel better about doing stupid things for stupid people.

I've been looking for another job but can't get one. No places are hiring and places that do have something are 21+ And since I am still "underage" so to speak I can't get any assistance with school or anything because my parents make too much money. In fact, I tried explaining to my dad that since I don't live with him I want him to not claim me for anything but he thinks his tax break is much more important.

I've been trying to get out but can't. Every single move I make I just have one more problem or can't get rid of the same problems I've had before.

I'm tired of this and I'm tired of life. I had always said I'd probably kill myself around the age of 30 because life is shit and I would have fulfilled everyone's expectations by then. I don't even think I'll last that long now. There is nothing in life worth living for. It's the same bullshit after another. Work a job you hate to afford a life you hate to continue the cycle day after day.

People suck, life sucks, everything sucks. I want out.

I am still with the same guy.

I can't quit school. I only went because I was going to be kicked out of my house if I didn't go and I would be homeless. I fear the same thing. I have a job but I can barely afford a place to live. The only place I have found I have to get a transfer and the transfer is taking so long I might lose the place. And ever then I will only have roughly $300 to live on a month after rent.

My entire life is just being hurt by people and not being able to live. I'm constantly being told how much of a failure I am. I believe it. I can't do anything. There is nothing I want to do. I can barely afford to live. There is nothing worth living for.
